item.title: 【SD Live Performances】LeAnn Rimes in Concert
item.description:
Well, it took me awhile, but I finally found the 1997 Disney Channel special concert, LeAnn Rimes in Concert, that aired on June 22, 1997. I did a bit of work on it as the quality was only 240p, so I did my best to fix the visual quality and upped it to its original 640x480 ratio, I didn't feel comfortable trying to upscale it any higher. The sound quality isn't the best, I tried my best to fix it but removing VHS sounds isn't my cup of tea. Anyway, I hope you guys enjoy. The file is 2.58 GB because it is a 50-minute special.
